entities.summary: Emil Fredrik Sandström was a Swedish lawyer. He was the chairman of the United Nations Special Committee on Palestine (UNSCOP) in 1947, and the chairman of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies from 1950 to 1959.
